title: Threads Scraper — Posts, Profiles, Hashtag & Keyword Search

mode.title: 🎯 Mode
mode.description: What do you want to scrape? Pick a mode and fill in the matching section below.

usernames.title: 👤 Usernames
usernames.description: Plain Threads usernames (no @, no URL). Example: zuck, mosseri. Used when Mode = User.

bulkUsernames.title: 📋 Bulk Usernames (paste)
bulkUsernames.description:
**One username per line**, press Enter between each. **No quotes, no commas.** Example:

```
zuck
mosseri
finkd
```

You can copy a column straight from Google Sheets or Excel. Merged into the Usernames list at runtime.

keywords.title: 🏷️ Keywords / Tags
keywords.description: Keywords for Search mode, or hashtags for Hashtag mode (leading # optional). Example: AI news, #寵物友善.

bulkKeywords.title: 📋 Bulk Keywords (paste)
bulkKeywords.description:
**One keyword or hashtag per line**, press Enter between each. **No quotes, no commas.** Example:

```
LLM agents
vibe coding
#AI
```

Merged into the Keywords list at runtime.

searchSort.title: 🔀 Search Sort
searchSort.description: Sort order for keyword search results. Only applies to Mode = Search.

dateFrom.title: 📅 Date From
dateFrom.description: Earliest post date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or a relative expression like "7 days", "1 month".

dateTo.title: 📅 Date To
dateTo.description: Latest post date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or a relative expression.

postUrls.title: 💬 Post URLs
postUrls.description: Full Threads post URLs. Used when Mode = Post. Example: https://www.threads.com/@user/post/ABC123.

feedUrls.title: 📰 Feed URLs
feedUrls.description: Threads custom feed URLs. Used when Mode = Feed. Example: https://www.threads.com/custom_feed/18113589370710265.

maxPosts.title: 📊 Max Posts
maxPosts.description: Maximum posts to scrape per source. Higher = more billable results ($0.005 each). Scrolling is auto-managed.
